card.name: Hyphen after hypo- or hyper-, and list dashes
card.fires_on: The hyphen or dash character, mainly right after the prefix hypo or hyper in paired terms like hypo- or hyperosmotic. It also fires on a dash that separates headlines or links in scraped web text.

modes.label: Hypo-/hyper- pairs
modes.description: A hyphen after hypo or hyper, where the next words are 'or hyper...' or a medical term.
modes.example: most importantly hypo<<->> or hyperosmotic hyponat

modes.label: Dash between web headlines
modes.description: A dash used as a separator between page links or headlines in web text.
